meridian-credits-release-1-0: Meridian Credits release 1.0 agreement (applies to all explicit "release":"1.0" requests and is current when release is omitted). Source: Finance-approved specification in issue trial-56h, 2026-09-07. A line has exactly nonempty string line_id/account_id/subscription_id, valid 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31 Gregorian service_on, and nonnegative integer charge_cents; line_id is request-unique. Subscription cap groups are (account_id, subscription_id), not subscription_id alone. Compute each uncapped line credit as floor(charge_cents * 10 / 100), then allocate a shared 2400-cent group cap by earliest service_on then increasing Unicode-code-point line_id; assigned line credit is min(uncapped credit, remaining cap). No service date excludes a line. Total credit is the sum of assigned credits and total due is charges minus credit. A one-line quote treats its supplied line as the complete statement: request {"command":"quote","line":LINE}, optionally explicit release 1.0; response has exactly release "1.0", copied line_id, credit_cents, and amount_due_cents.
